method: Viewed all six page thumbnails in every sheet using view_image. Sheets 14–20 were each reopened individually after a truncated batch result; the truncated batch is not counted as inspection.
verdict: PASS for layout, with one minor source-notation typography flag
layout_findings: No clipping, overlap, margin overflow, missing page numbers, or unusable page breaks observed at thumbnail scale. Equations and tables remain inside the text area.

minor_flags.description: EtHolds paragraph appears to print literal TeX delimiters/commands around a forall/IsUnit predicate. This may be intentionally quoted source notation; it is not a layout blocker.
